Enthiran வெறும் Sci-Fi Movie இல்ல… AI-ஐ புரிஞ்சிக்க ஒரு நல்ல Starting Point! 
இந்த video-ல Enthiran (Robot) movie-ஐ AI perspective-ல பார்க்கப் போறோம். Artificial Intelligence எப்படி work ஆகுது, ஒரு AI system எப்படி learn பண்ணும், Human Intelligence vs Artificial Intelligence என்ன difference, AI எங்கே போயிட்டு இருக்கு போன்ற concepts-ஐ simple #aiagents #agenticai  Tamil-ல discuss பண்ணியிருக்கேன்.


இந்த Video-ல என்ன பார்க்கப் போறோம்?
Enthiran movie concepts-ஐ real-world AI-உடன் connect பண்ணி, AI என்றால் என்ன, Machine Learning, Deep Learning, Generative AI, AI Agents போன்ற concepts எப்படி ஒன்றோட ஒன்று connect ஆகுது என்பதை beginner-friendly ஆக பார்க்கலாம்.
🚀 AI கத்துக்க எங்கிருந்து Start பண்ணலாம்?
AI-க்கு புதுசா இருக்கீங்கனா எல்லாத்தையும் ஒரே நேரத்தில் கத்துக்க முயற்சி பண்ண வேண்டாம். AI Fundamentals → Machine Learning → Deep Learning → Generative AI → AI Agents என்று step-by-step போகலாம்.
Structured learning-க்கு video-ல DeepLearning.AI courses-ஐயும் reference பண்ணியிருக்கேன்.

videos.title: Rick Rubin: What Jay-Z Did in 30 Minutes Left Me Speechless!
videos.description:
Discover the spiritual and psychological creative process that legendary producer Rick Rubin uses to help the world's biggest artists transcend and achieve greatness.

Rick Rubin is the co-founder of Def Jam Recordings, the author of the philosophical bestseller _The Creative Act: A Way of Being,_ and has a new documentary called JAY-Z in 8 available on HBO Max and Mubi. Having collaborated with icons like Jay-Z, Johnny Cash, Adele, Tom Petty, and Kanye West, Rubin does not rely on commercial metrics or audience testing to guide his workflow. He shares practical strategies for dismantling the prisons of identity, harnessing the power of "indefensible" ideas, and cultivating a state of pure creative freedom.

*In this episode, he explains:*
■ *The "Indefensible" Act:* Why the greatest artistic breakthroughs defy logic and market research.
■ *The Vacuum Strategy:* How walking away from obligations that no longer serve you creates an energetic void, allowing the universe to present massive unexpected opportunities.
■ *The Audience Trap:* Why focusing on commercial incentives and audience expectations completely undermines the creative process.
■ *Deconstructing the Greats:* The psychological traits that separate good musicians from generational icons.
■ *The Trauma of Success:* Rubin opens up about his crippling depressive episode at age 33 after a corporate restructuring at Def Jam.
